blocks.text: Amino acids compounds ka aik ahem group hain jin mein yeh dono hote hain:

Is wajah se amino acids amphoteric hain, yaani acid aur base dono ki tarah kaam kar sakte hain. Amino acids (2-aminocarboxylic acids), jinhein α-amino acids bhi kehte hain, ki aam banawat neeche di gayi hai.

blocks.alt: Dashed dabbon mein teen khuli banawatein: amino acid ki aam banawat R-C(H)(NH2)-COOH; natural structure, jis mein COOH ka H gol daire mein aur aik teer use NH2 ke lone pair tak le jata hai; aur zwitter ionic structure R-C(H)(NH3+)-COO-.
blocks.caption: Amino acid ki aam banawat, natural structure aur zwitter ionic structure (kitab ke PDF safha 129 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehla dabba amino acid ki aam banawat hai. Doosre dabbe (‘natural structure’) mein teer dikhata hai ke -COOH ka H (proton) amino group ke nitrogen ke lone pair par chala jata hai. Is se zwitterion banta hai: -COO⁻ (negative) aur -NH₃⁺ (positive). Kitab ne zwitterion mein ‘COO’ aur ‘Nh₃’ bina charge ke chhapa hai; sahi shakal COO⁻ aur NH₃⁺ hai, jo drawing mein hai.

α-Amino acid aik dipolar ion ki shakal mein hota hai jise zwitterion kehte hain; is ke aik hi molecule mein aik positive aur aik negative sira hota hai. Zwitterion bante waqt proton carboxyl group se amino group par chala jata hai. Is dipolar banawat ko internal salt (andaruni namak) bhi kehte hain.

R group amino acid ka woh hissa hai jo har amino acid mein mukhtalif hota hai. Sab se saada amino acid glycine (aminoethanoic acid) hai, jis mein R hydrogen atom hai. Alanine (2-aminopropanoic acid) mein R group methyl group, -CH₃, hai.

blocks.alt: Glycine, H-C(H)(NH2)-COOH, aur alanine, CH3-C(H)(NH2)-COOH, khuli banawat mein.
blocks.caption: Glycine aur alanine (kitab ke PDF safha 129 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Glycine ke siwa tamam α-amino acids chiral hain (glycine ke α-carbon par do H hain, is liye chaar mukhtalif groups nahi).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq 20 α-amino acids mein se 10 essential hain (jism inhein nahi bana sakta) aur 10 non-essential hain (jism bana sakta hai). Aksar kitabon mein baraon (adults) ke liye 9 essential amino acids diye jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Glycine wahid aam α-amino acid kyun hai jo chiral nahi?
blocks.explanation: Is ke α-carbon par do hydrogen atoms hain (R = H), is liye us par chaar mukhtalif groups nahi.

items: Amino acids mein -NH₂ aur -COOH dono: amphoteric.
Glycine: R = H (chiral nahi); alanine: R = CH₃.
